data.name: Drunk Parking
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Drunk Parking — the only game where your biggest enemy isn’t traffic, the police, or tight parking spots… it’s your own questionable life choices.

You play as a driver who absolutely should not be behind the wheel, attempting to complete the simplest task imaginable: park the car. Sounds easy? Not when your steering feels like it’s arguing with you, your sense of direction comes and goes, and every obstacle in the city seems personally offended by your existence.

Navigate through increasingly chaotic levels filled with tight spaces, moving cars, pedestrians who may or may not respect your presence, and the ever-growing risk of attracting police attention. The more mistakes you make, the worse things get — but somehow, you still believe this next attempt will be perfect.

Earn rewards for your… “skills,” unlock new cars, upgrade your ride, and experiment with just how bad your decisions can get. Want more challenge? Push your limits and see how far you can go without completely losing control.

Key Features:

  • Unpredictable driving that keeps every attempt fresh (and slightly concerning)

  • Dynamic obstacles and a city that refuses to cooperate

  • Progression system with unlockable cars and upgrades

  • Risk vs reward gameplay — the worse you behave, the better the payoff (if you survive)

  • Quick, addictive levels perfect for “just one more try” (you’ll say that a lot)

You know you shouldn’t play this.
But you also know you will.

data.short_description: You had one job: park the car. The problem? You’re doing it drunk. Drunk Parking is a chaotic physics-based driving game where simple parking turns into a complete mess. Fight unpredictable controls, overcorrect every turn, and try to land your car perfectly in a city full of obstacles.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • Storage: 1 GB available space
